findings.title: Keep unfiltered snapshots out of the repository object store
findings.body: In a repository using an encryption clean filter, replacing that filter with `cat` makes `candidate_tree()` write plaintext blobs through `git add -A`. Only the index is temporary; the objects remain in the repository’s object database after review. Previously, the clean filter encrypted those bytes before storage.

findings.title: Preserve timeout status when the reviewer has already exited
findings.body: A reviewer that prints `No findings.`, starts a background process inheriting stdout, and exits zero triggers `TimeoutExpired` while draining its pipes. This branch cleans up and returns `ran` with exit zero, producing a passed receipt without fallback. The same scenario returned `timeout` at the base commit.

findings.title: Validate carried findings before promoting the final verdict
findings.body: If Codex exits nonzero with only a finding header, `parse_answer()` returns no valid status but retains the header with an empty body. This line carries it forward anyway; a subsequent clean Claude response is converted into conclusive `findings`. The resulting evidence therefore bypasses the new requirement that every finding include a scenario.

findings.title: Enumerate filter keys without parsing command values
findings.body: A valid multiline filter command containing a whitespace-only line, such as `cat\n  \nexit 0`, makes this comprehension raise `IndexError`: the line passes `if line`, but `line.split()` is empty. Because enumeration happens before review, even an unused configured filter can now abort the runner without producing a result.

[P1] Keep unfiltered snapshots out of the repository object store — skills/code-review/scripts/review_diff.py:80

In a repository using an encryption clean filter, replacing that filter with `cat` makes `candidate_tree()` write plaintext blobs through `git add -A`. Only the index is temporary; the objects remain in the repository’s object database after review. Previously, the clean filter encrypted those bytes before storage.

[P2] Preserve timeout status when the reviewer has already exited — skills/code-review/scripts/review_diff.py:213

A reviewer that prints `No findings.`, starts a background process inheriting stdout, and exits zero triggers `TimeoutExpired` while draining its pipes. This branch cleans up and returns `ran` with exit zero, producing a passed receipt without fallback. The same scenario returned `timeout` at the base commit.

[P2] Validate carried findings before promoting the final verdict — skills/code-review/scripts/review_diff.py:332

If Codex exits nonzero with only a finding header, `parse_answer()` returns no valid status but retains the header with an empty body. This line carries it forward anyway; a subsequent clean Claude response is converted into conclusive `findings`. The resulting evidence therefore bypasses the new requirement that every finding include a scenario.

[P2] Enumerate filter keys without parsing command values — skills/code-review/scripts/review_diff.py:79

A valid multiline filter command containing a whitespace-only line, such as `cat\n  \nexit 0`, makes this comprehension raise `IndexError`: the line passes `if line`, but `line.split()` is empty. Because enumeration happens before review, even an unused configured filter can now abort the runner without producing a result.
